result.summary: Extends the `checktxinputs_invalid_transactions_test` helper in `transaction_tests.cpp` to support transactions with multiple inputs. Adds a test case where two inputs are individually valid under `MoneyRange` but their sum exceeds `MAX_MONEY`. This verifies that `Consensus::CheckTxInputs` rejects transactions whose cumulative input values exceed consensus limits.
result.problem: Existing unit tests for `Consensus::CheckTxInputs` only tested single-input transactions where `coin.out.nValue == nValueIn`. Consequently, mutations or bugs in the cumulative value check `!MoneyRange(nValueIn)` (such as switching `||` to `&&` in the out-of-range condition) passed unit tests undetected.
evidence: PR description points to MutantHub mutant #275 showing `if (!MoneyRange(coin.out.nValue) || !MoneyRange(nValueIn))` mutated to `&&` survived the test suite.
result.changed_since_previous: No changes; diff matches the previously described implementation.
result.card: This PR updates CheckTxInputs unit tests to support multiple inputs and adds a test case where individually valid input amounts exceed MAX_MONEY when summed. Previously, unit tests only checked single-input transactions, leaving a mutation that changes the out-of-range check from logical OR to logical AND undetected. The change is restricted to transaction unit tests.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests in transaction_tests.cpp.
